proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.within_feet_of_item
proposed_widenings.justification: The current activation gate vocabulary can express holding or wearing an item, but not being near one without holding it.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While you are within 5 feet of this brazier, you can take a Magic action to summon a Fire Elemental.

proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemSpawnedCreatureMechanics placement anchored on item
proposed_widenings.justification: The current summon surface records only a coarse range header and cannot state that the creature appears in the nearest valid space relative to the item.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the brazier as possible.

notes: Typecheck and tracer both passed. The authored trace is usable, but it relies on a deliberate approximation: `holding_item` in place of the RAW 5-foot proximity gate. Language comprehension is also omitted from mechanics and carried only in description/proposal notes.
